_doc: mu. music edit for the Down With Hunger explainer (music supervisor). One track: 'Onion Capers' by Kevin MacLeod (CC BY 4.0), 105.0016 BPM measured, Rubber Band stretched to the picture's 104 BPM (ratio 0.99046, about 1 %). Source grid: downbeats at 0.8764 + 2.28568*n s (arrange.py, phase confidence 1.06, residual 3.2 ms, 100 % inliers; the 4-bar F G C F phrases change chord exactly on these bar lines). Re-cut 2026-11-01 for the 27-line script (163.2 s): every 'at' is a film bar line (n*2.30769 s) except the button; the drop on film bar 26 (60.0 s) under l11.

ENDING src bars 50-55 (A4, the track's own last phrase) -> film bar 63 (145.38), on the wipe into 'surprise'; splice C (src 47) -> C (src 50) same chord; ends on the track's own stop after beat 3 of src bar 55 (music silent from film ~158.8, under the end of l25)

BUTTON: the track's final hit as its own segment, its attack on the brick placard slam close:stamp:0 = 159.846 s (a 1.05 s comic stop-time after the track's own stop), ringing out under the 2.60 s end-card hold (tail_fade 2.0)
